відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"I built this outfit around the grey suit you asked for: jacket, vest and wide trousers in one tone make a calm, polished base for work. The short vest marks your waist, so the wide trousers keep a clear line. The silver earrings are the ones you wanted, and the necklace is the accent in jewelry you mentioned. The shoes are at the right level for a working day. The whole outfit is a little smarter than an ordinary office day needs, and I kept it that way on purpose. One thing is missing: a top that suits this outfit, because the one here is not the right kind of piece.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the suit's jacket open over its vest to take a little of the formality off.\",\"Let the necklace be the one accent and keep the silver earrings small beside it.\",\"Let the wide trouser hems fall to the shoes so the grey line stays unbroken.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[\"#286·22\"],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#277·12\",\"what\":\"grey suit with jacket, vest and trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#286·22\",\"what\":\"top\"},{\"n\":\"#145·21\",\"what\":\"shoes\"},{\"n\":\"#279·35\",\"what\":\"silver earrings\"},{\"n\":\"#449·25\",\"what\":\"necklace\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#277·12\",\"text\":\"You asked for a grey suit, so it is the centre of the outfit. It sits a touch smarter than an everyday workday, and I chose it on purpose.\"},{\"n\":\"#145·21\",\"text\":\"Their level fits a working day, so they suit your occasion. I cannot say how comfortable they will be over long hours, as I do not know how long you will be on your feet or on what surface.\"},{\"n\":\"#13·43\",\"text\":\"I chose this bag as a practical companion for the working day.
